base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: DeepSeek API root used for both tools, for example https://api.deepseek.com. Do not include /v1 or endpoint paths.

timeout_seconds.title: Call timeout
timeout_seconds.description: Total time budget in seconds for one Search or Fetch call, including retries.

max_retries.title: Retry count
max_retries.description: Additional attempts for HTTP 408, 429, and 5xx responses or network failures.

default_count.title: Default result count
default_count.description: Number of results used when the search tool omits count.

default_need_content.title: Return content by default
default_need_content.description: Whether search returns page content when the tool omits need_content.

max_content_chars.title: Per-result content limit
max_content_chars.description: Maximum characters of each search result's content included in the model-visible output. Fetch output is bounded by the Host tool result limit.
